name: TOOSII-XD-ULTRA
description: TOOSII-XD-ULTRA — Baileys WhatsApp bot with prefix commands

SESSION_ID.description: Your bot session ID. Leave empty to link with a pairing code.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner number in international format, no plus sign (e.g. 254712345678).

RESTART_SUPERVISED.description: Lets the owner-only .restart command exit, relying on the platform to start the process again.

TOOSII_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional override for the primary media/AI API base URL.

MOVIE_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional override for the movie API base URL.

TOOSII_TECH_BASE_URL.description: Optional override for the Toosii Tech developer API base URL.
